title: Korean Cinema and the Saudi Audience
summary: In recent years, Korean cinema has gained growing popularity among Saudi audiences, driven by the strength of its storytelling, the diversity of its cinematic experiences, and the global rise of Korean culture. Held in with Korea’s selection as the festival’s Guest of Honor, this panel explores the evolving relationship between Korean cinema and Saudi audiences from both artistic and cultural perspectives. The discussion brings together filmmakers and actors from Korea alongside one of Saudi Arabia’s prominent voices with a strong interest in Korean cinema, to examine the reasons behind this cultural connection, the role of film festivals and digital audiences in expanding
